lines.text: Jesus led Peter, James, and John up a high mountain, where His face shone like the sun.
Moses and Elijah appeared and talked with Jesus, and Peter offered to put up three shelters.
A bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice called Jesus its faithful servant, so the disciples fell facedown in terror.
Jesus touched them and told them not to be afraid, then told them to tell no one until the Passover feast had ended.

wrong_details.true: the Son of Man has been raised from the dead

lines.text: Jesus said Elijah had already come and was not recognized, and the disciples understood He meant John the Baptist.
